title: I released an AI-assisted mobile action RPG 18 months ago. I'm still updating it.
author: DoubleJayM
selftext:
While Codex is working on my next update, I thought I'd share where my game is now.

I'm the solo developer of Broken Soul, an action RPG on Google Play. The combat is about reading enemy patterns, timing parries and dodges, and moving around a grid built for mobile controls.

I started making it with AI coding tools about a year and a half ago and released it back then. I've spent more than a year maintaining it and improving the game, with hundreds of build updates along the way.

The player base is small, but some people have stuck with it. That's a big part of why I keep working on it. The AI tools have improved a lot since I started, and lately I've been using that progress to keep improving this same game.

Right now I'm working on expanding the roster to eight characters with different combat styles. That update is still in development. The public build currently has four playable characters.

I wanted to share what a game made this way looks like after a long stretch of maintenance and iteration. If you try it, I'd appreciate specific feedback on the combat and controls, especially anything that feels awkward on a phone.

Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xyz.brokensoul.mygame](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xyz.brokensoul.mygame)  
Free to download, with in-app purchases.

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: I feel like the concept/mechanic is very good and has lots of potential but it still lacks something idk what.

replies.author: DoubleJayM
replies.body: Thanks for taking a look! Was it something about the combat feel, the visuals, or how the fights flowed? Even a moment that felt a bit off would help me figure out what to improve.
